description: The contract every Final flow app is built against: which files the ENGINE owns (never write them — they are re-asserted verbatim), the baseline package.json (Vite + React 19 + TS + Tailwind + command-frame), the rules your files must follow, and the runtime contracts that compile and preview fine but fail on a real device (money in minor units, the first-load handshake, getX response unwrapping, tender success semantics). Call this once before writing any files; pass `device` for layout guidance.

device.description: Target surface — "portrait-handheld", "counter-tablet", "wall-kiosk" or "tv-display". Approximate words work ("kiosk", "phone", "menu board"); an unrecognized value just returns the device-agnostic contract.
